examples.en: To polish up your article, you can use more figures of speech such as metaphors.
examples.zh: 为了给你的文章润色，你可以更多地使用例如比喻等修辞手法。

examples.en: Examine types of sentences they use, pay attention to their metaphors, and focus on stories you feel you could write a pretty cool sequel to.
examples.zh: 检查他们使用的句子类型，注意他们的隐喻，并专注于你认为可以写出很酷的续篇的故事。

examples.en: By using stale metaphors, similes, and idioms, you save much mental effort, at the cost of leaving your meaning vague.
examples.zh: 使用陈腐的暗喻、明喻和习语，你省了不少思考的力气，代价是你的意义的模糊。
